name: evals
description: LLM eval hygiene: build-judge (build and validate an LLM judge: Hamel Husain's evals-skills procedure plus house rules, TPR/TNR on a held-out split), spot-check (a subagent reads a stratified high/middle/low sample of scored items and flags scores too high, too low or broken, before a human looks) and tune-prompt (tune a new prompt-driven component live, one case at a time: sealed prediction, run, blind human verdict scored against the agent's sealed bet, log, change the prompt on patterns).
